blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Медсестра ___ (обработать, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) рану пациента.
exercises.prompt: The nurse will treat the patient's wound.
exercises.why: **обработать → обработает** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я пойду ___ (завести, pf., fut. 1st sg.) машину.
exercises.prompt: I'll go and start the car.
exercises.why: **завести → заведу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: ___ (увидеться, pf., fut. 1st pl.) на Рождество.
exercises.prompt: See you at Christmas.
exercises.why: **увидеться → Увидимся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Если вам нужно перевести что-нибудь на берберский, ___ (попросить, pf., imper. pl.) Амастана.
exercises.prompt: If you have anything to translate into Berber, ask Amastan.
exercises.why: **попросить → попросите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Доказательство ___ (оставить, pf., fut. 1st pl.) читателю.
exercises.prompt: The proof is left to the reader.
exercises.why: **оставить → оставим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Давай ___ (сыграть, pf., fut. 1st pl.) в гляделки.
exercises.prompt: Let's have a staring contest.
exercises.why: **сыграть → сыграем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.q: Следуй велениям своего сердца, оно никогда не ___ (обмануть, pf., fut. 3rd sg.).
exercises.prompt: Follow your heart, for it never lies.
exercises.why: **обмануть → обманет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Как можешь ты быть уверен, что твоя подруга не ___ (симулировать, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) оргазмы?
exercises.prompt: How can you be sure your girlfriend isn't faking her orgasms?
exercises.why: **симулировать → симулирует** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: ___ (сохранить, pf., fut. 1st pl.) тропический лес!
exercises.prompt: Save the rainforest!
exercises.why: **сохранить → Сохраним** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (послать, pf., fut. 1st pl.) ей открытку.
exercises.prompt: We'll send her a card.
exercises.why: **послать → пошлём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (отойти, pf., fut. 1st pl.) на минутку.
exercises.prompt: Excuse us for a minute.
exercises.why: **отойти → отойдём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Царапки не ___ (дать, pf., fut. 3rd pl.) ребёнку повредить лицо.
exercises.prompt: Cotton mittens will prevent the baby from scratching her own face.
exercises.why: **дать → дадут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Давайте ___ (начать, pf., fut. 1st pl.) загодя. Я не люблю рисковать.
exercises.prompt: Let's start in plenty of time. I don't like to take risks.
exercises.why: **начать → начнём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.q: Надеюсь, я не ___ (заболеть, pf., fut. 1st sg.).
exercises.prompt: I hope that I don't get sick.
exercises.why: **заболеть → заболею** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Не ___ (оказать, pf., fut. 2nd pl.) мне услугу?
exercises.prompt: Please do me a favor, will you?
exercises.why: **оказать → окажете** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Это её очень ___ (обрадовать, pf., fut. 3rd sg.).
exercises.prompt: That'll make her very happy.
exercises.why: **обрадовать → обрадует** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Если человеческая природа ___ (эволюционировать, pf., fut. 3rd sg.), то ненамного быстрее, чем геологический профиль Земли.
exercises.prompt: If human nature is evolving, it's not much faster than the geological profile of the Earth.
exercises.why: **эволюционировать → эволюционирует** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: На этом заводе ___ (рафинировать, pf., fut. 3rd pl.) сырую нефть.
exercises.prompt: Crude oil is refined at this plant.
exercises.why: **рафинировать → рафинируют** — present-type form, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Откуда ___ (отходить, pf., fut. 3rd sg.) автобус?
exercises.prompt: Where does the bus leave from?
exercises.why: **отходить → отходит** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Поезд сейчас ___ (тронуться, pf., fut. 3rd sg.).
exercises.prompt: The train is about to leave.
exercises.why: **тронуться → тронется** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
